item.title: J.K. Dobbins: Hoping to play Week 3
item.description:
The Broncos are optimistic that Dobbins sustained only a minor hamstring injury during Sunday's 20-13 win over the Jaguars and will be available to play Week 3 versus the Rams, James Palmer of The Athletic reports.

item.title: Dallas Goedert: Set for tests on knee injury
item.description:
Goedert (knee) is slated to undergo an MRI on Monday after exiting Sunday's 24-20 win over the Titans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Xavier Worthy: Five catches in Week 2 win
item.description:
Worthy brought in five of seven targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in the Chiefs' 33-30 overtime win over the Colts on Sunday night.

item.title: Travis Kelce: Signature showing in OT win
item.description:
Kelce secured nine of 11 targets for 101 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 33-30 overtime win over the Colts on Sunday night.

item.title: Rashee Rice: Robust yardage total in OT win
item.description:
